critical_code_review_comments: DemoForm.jsx L115-132 guard `if (!isMobile) return;` at L117 correctly restricts the useEffect handler to the mobile-popup path. Since isMobile is state-tracked via a resize listener (L96-101), the effect re-subscribes if the viewport crosses the 768 breakpoint mid-session — this is safe because scheduledRef also gates against double-fire within the same booking.

CalendlyInline.jsx L91-107 remains sole owner of the desktop-inline demo_booked push with form_location='calendly'. Both handlers still have local `scheduledRef`/`scheduled` idempotency guards, providing defense-in-depth beyond the isMobile branch.
